programme.title: Men In War
programme.desc: In Korea, on 6 September 1950, Lieutenant Benson's platoon finds itself isolated in enemy-held territory after a retreat. Soon they are joined by Sergeant Montana, whose overriding concern is caring for his catatonic colonel. Benson and Montana can't stand each other, but together they must get the survivors to Hill 465, where they hope the division is waiting. It's a long, harrowing march, fraught with all the dangers the elusive enemy can summon.

programme.title: The Comic

Packed with sharp satire, big laughs, and a bittersweet look behind the curtain of showbiz, The Comic delivers a fast, funny, and unforgettable ride through the life of a comedy genius who just can’t get out of his own way. A must-see for film lovers and comedy fans alike.

programme.title: Marie's Story

For them, the hold-ups are part of a last-ditch scheme to take back a future that was stolen from under them. Vengeance seems to be theirs until they find themselves on the radar of Marcus (Jeff Bridges), a Texas Ranger looking for one last grand pursuit on the eve of his retirement.

It's a long, harrowing march, fraught with all the dangers the elusive enemy can summon.

programme.desc: Bordeaux's world-famous vineyards are undergoing a revival as vintners seek to update their wines by introducing new technology and the reinvention older traditions. Eva visits St. Emillion where wine production began 1000 years ago and enjoys unusual wine pairings - a deep red with fish, and a buttery white with cheese. But Bordeaux isn't just about wine, it had superb produce; succulent duck and tender beef as well as 200-million-year-old caviar, served with signature Bordelaise sauces.

programme.desc: An adventurous tale of two young drifters who wildly rob their way West during the Civil War.

programme.title: Wonderfully Beautiful
programme.desc: Following five very different women and their daunting task of finding out what beauty is all about. As mothers, daughters and girlfriends, the women search for new body awareness and self confidence.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: Megan Spencer, Jaimie Leonarder and Fenella Kernebone present reviews, interviews and an insider's view of the world of movies, while Marc Fennell reviews new-release DVDs.

programme.title: Men In War
programme.desc: In Korea, on 6 September 1950, Lieutenant Benson's platoon finds itself isolated in enemy-held territory after a retreat. Soon they are joined by Sergeant Montana, whose overriding concern is caring for his catatonic colonel. Benson and Montana can't stand each other, but together they must get the survivors to Hill 465, where they hope the division is waiting. It's a long, harrowing march, fraught with all the dangers the elusive enemy can summon.

programme.title: The Comic
programme.desc: Step into the golden age of Hollywood with Billy Bright, a slapstick legend whose rise to fame is as hilarious as his downfall is shocking. Packed with sharp satire, big laughs, and a bittersweet look behind the curtain of showbiz, The Comic delivers a fast, funny, and unforgettable ride through the life of a comedy genius who just can’t get out of his own way. A must-see for film lovers and comedy fans alike.

programme.title: Godzilla Minus One
programme.desc: In postwar Japan, a new terror rises; Godzilla. Will the devastated people be able to survive... let alone fight back?

programme.title: In A Land That No Longer Exists
programme.desc: Exploring fashion in the former GDR, this film highlights iconic Sibylle magazine, state brand Exquisit, and the underground creative subculture behind East Germany's style scene.

programme.title: Selkie
programme.desc: Jamie, a troubled lonely teenager, gets a new lease on life when he comes upon a group of selkies, mythical people with the power to change into seals. Directed by Donald Crombie and stars Bryan Marshall, Celine O'Leary and Shimon Moore.

programme.title: Marie's Story
programme.desc: After a tragic accident, Marie struggles to rebuild her life and rediscover hope, confronting grief, forgiveness, and the power of human connection in this moving drama.

programme.title: The Ploughman's Lunch
programme.desc: James Penfield (Jonathan Pryce) has made a career out of journalism. Now bankrupt, he finds himself with a group of other writers in the middle of the dispute-ridden British homeland at the time of the Falklands War.

programme.title: The Whole Truth
programme.desc: Richard Ramsay defends 17-year-old Mike Lassiter, accused of murdering his father. As secrets unfold, Ramsay and colleague Janelle uncover hidden truths in a tense courtroom battle.

programme.title: Hell or High Water
programme.desc: After years of estrangement, brothers Toby (Chris Pine) and Tanner (Ben Foster) decide to rob the branches of the West Texan bank threatening to foreclose on their family land. For them, the hold-ups are part of a last-ditch scheme to take back a future that was stolen from under them. Vengeance seems to be theirs until they find themselves on the radar of Marcus (Jeff Bridges), a Texas Ranger looking for one last grand pursuit on the eve of his retirement.

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Fillers
programme.desc: Hosts Adam Liaw, Renee Lim and Lily Serna meet passionate growers, celebrated chefs and local food heroes from all over Australia.

programme.title: Come Dine With Me UK

programme.title: Come Dine With Me UK
programme.desc: Second to host this week in Manchester is plumber and adult merchandise director, Richard and he's cooking a rich and indulgent menu.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw

programme.desc: Luke’s penultimate stop of his train journey is Hanoi, the second largest city of Vietnam located on the Red River. There is one dish Luke always has when he visits Hanoi and that’s Bun Cha.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke visited Sapa high in the hills in Northern Vietnam fifteen years ago. He's pleased to find out that not much has changed, and visits a little girl he befriended during that time. She welcomes him into her house and learns how the local dish of dried buffalo is made. He also goes foraging for botanicals with a scientist who is making Vietnam's very first gin.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen

programme.desc: Denise Andrews Macale, with the help of Mitch and Ali, turns the humble bush turkey into a delicious stew using basic vegetables and Asian sauces to complement the gamey taste of this native bird.

programme.sub-title: Curry Fried Chicken With Hot Honey
programme.desc: Fried chicken is always a crowd favorite, and Rachael takes it up a notch with a homemade curry and yogurt marinade that transforms her signature 'shake and fry' method into something special.

programme.desc: Mike starts with a recipe he learned in London, Salt Baked Bream. Laura follows with Asian-inspired Satay Chicken Wing Skewers. Mike then returns with his rich and decadent Banoffee Pie Sundae.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Every so often it's nice to treat yourself and your loved ones to something special and for Lidia and her family, that means lobster night!

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programme.desc: It's a perfect day for Ina when the incredible actress and self confessed foodie Emily Mortimer joins her for a fantastic day of cooking and conversation at the barn.

programme.title: Freshly Picked
programme.desc: In search of tasty fresh vegetables for his Cime Di Rapa Orecchiette, Simon is heading to Kinsfolk Farm today.

programme.title: Food Safari Earth
programme.desc: Maeve O'Meara explores the delicious world of tropical fruits and vegetables with recipes from Asia, the Pacific and South America. She explores Australia's enduring love for Asian flavours with a visit to the master of Thai cuisine, David Thompson, who shares his recipe for the most delicious, all-vegetarian Pad See Ew. Then Colombian-born chef, Oscar Espinosa showcases the power of the power of the plantain, transforming them into crunchy chips, served with a guacamole.

programme.title: Andy's East Coast Kitchen Crawl
programme.desc: Andy lands on The Rock in St. John's to eat like a Newfoundlander. He tries moose meat, scrunchions, steamed cod and a local twist on Chinese food. Then it's back home for baked beans and toutons.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield

programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 1

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 2
programme.desc: Luke takes us behind the scenes of his latest venture in Sydney. He explores his innovate machinery and high tech kitchen before meeting Head Chef Kenji to cook popular recipes from their menu. At the Sydney Fish Markets Luke meets with Executive Chef Chase Kojima and they plate up a Kingfish Ceviche before meeting with Paul Carmichael to learn more about Caribbean cuisine. Luke then meets Alan Benson, his photographer for his next book.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde gives summer a run for its money by cooking on his grill. He gives the people a delicious feast of burgers, fries, lamb, and many more.

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Saskatchewan produces nearly 80 percent of all the mustard in Canada and is one of the largest exporters of mustard in the world.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen

programme.desc: This episode is a salute to the fighting freshwater and saltwater barramundi. Alex Rogers whips up a simple dish with one of his favourite fish.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Meal To Make You Smile, A

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten

Ann shares childhood revelations, her winning formula to writing 9 best-selling novels and why she decided to open a bookstore in Nashville. They both love Charlie Birds Farro salad so it’s on the menu for lunch along with Ina’s Jammy Eggs and Ann’s favorite Roasted cauliflower, one delicious grain salad two ways.

Eva visits St. Emillion where wine production began 1000 years ago and enjoys unusual wine pairings - a deep red with fish, and a buttery white with cheese. But Bordeaux isn't just about wine, it had superb produce; succulent duck and tender beef as well as 200-million-year-old caviar, served with signature Bordelaise sauces.

programme.title: Men In War
programme.desc: In Korea, on 6 September 1950, Lieutenant Benson's platoon finds itself isolated in enemy-held territory after a retreat. Soon they are joined by Sergeant Montana, whose overriding concern is caring for his catatonic colonel. Benson and Montana can't stand each other, but together they must get the survivors to Hill 465, where they hope the division is waiting. It's a long, harrowing march, fraught with all the dangers the elusive enemy can summon.

programme.title: The Comic
programme.desc: Step into the golden age of Hollywood with Billy Bright, a slapstick legend whose rise to fame is as hilarious as his downfall is shocking. Packed with sharp satire, big laughs, and a bittersweet look behind the curtain of showbiz, The Comic delivers a fast, funny, and unforgettable ride through the life of a comedy genius who just can’t get out of his own way. A must-see for film lovers and comedy fans alike.

For them, the hold-ups are part of a last-ditch scheme to take back a future that was stolen from under them. Vengeance seems to be theirs until they find themselves on the radar of Marcus (Jeff Bridges), a Texas Ranger looking for one last grand pursuit on the eve of his retirement.

Benson and Montana can't stand each other, but together they must get the survivors to Hill 465, where they hope the division is waiting. It's a long, harrowing march, fraught with all the dangers the elusive enemy can summon.

A must-see for film lovers and comedy fans alike.

Soon they are joined by Sergeant Montana, whose overriding concern is caring for his catatonic colonel. Benson and Montana can't stand each other, but together they must get the survivors to Hill 465, where they hope the division is waiting. It's a long, harrowing march, fraught with all the dangers the elusive enemy can summon.

A must-see for film lovers and comedy fans alike.

Soon they are joined by Sergeant Montana, whose overriding concern is caring for his catatonic colonel. Benson and Montana can't stand each other, but together they must get the survivors to Hill 465, where they hope the division is waiting. It's a long, harrowing march, fraught with all the dangers the elusive enemy can summon.

A must-see for film lovers and comedy fans alike.

Maeve joins her friend, homecook Franca Norris and her father, Angelo Bonacci, on a mushroom hunt amongst the pine trees before discovering the secrets of perfect gnocchi with mushroom sauce. Preserving guru Pietro Demaio then demonstrates how easy it is to bottle your own olives, while acclaimed chef Peter Conistis makes magnificent olive and tomato keftedes with a green olive sauce.

programme.title: Andy's East Coast Kitchen Crawl
programme.desc: In the home of the world's best oysters, Andy wades into P.E.I.'s aquaculture on an oyster farm, hauls in giant halibut and tastes savoury potato pies.

programme.title: Yes, Chef!

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: Revisiting one of his favourite regions in Europe, Will Studd explores the challenges facing the traditional raw milk cheesemakers of Normandy, long renowned for its quality dairy products. Will introduces his daughter Ellie to the famous benchmark cheese Camembert de Normandie, and together they visit the last remaining organic, farmhouse producer of this iconic cheese.

programme.title: Taiwan Bites
programme.desc: How can a cuisine with less than a hundred years of history be considered traditional? Eric travels from Germany to Taiwan, to unearth connection between his people and the recipes in their culture.

programme.title: Anne Boleyn
programme.desc: Anne is haunted by nightmares of her still-born son. Having lost the baby, her position at court is in serious jeopardy. But Anne is a fighter, and she forces herself out of bed. Her new mission is to secure her daughter's right to the throne. But she quickly discovers that Cromwell has other ideas – he has been bartering the royal lineage in return for a political deal with Spain.

programme.title: Michael Mosley Secrets Of The Superagers
programme.desc: Dr Michael Mosley travels the world to meet extraordinary 'superagers'. In this episode about the senses, Michael meets a 73-year-old jazz musician in Chicago and discovers why playing music can prevent the hearing loss. In the town of Grasse, in France, he compares his sense of smell with a 75-year-old perfumer. Michael also reveals why aerobic exercise can help our eyesight and prevent the onset of glaucoma; one of the most common causes of age-related blindness.

programme.desc: In Korea, on 6 September 1950, Lieutenant Benson's platoon finds itself isolated in enemy-held territory after a retreat. Soon they are joined by Sergeant Montana, whose overriding concern is caring for his catatonic colonel. Benson and Montana can't stand each other, but together they must get the survivors to Hill 465, where they hope the division is waiting. It's a long, harrowing march, fraught with all the dangers the elusive enemy can summon.

Packed with sharp satire, big laughs, and a bittersweet look behind the curtain of showbiz, The Comic delivers a fast, funny, and unforgettable ride through the life of a comedy genius who just can’t get out of his own way. A must-see for film lovers and comedy fans alike.

Ann's best selling book Tom Lake is set on a cherry orchard so Ina is welcoming her with a simple country dessert, Cherry Clafouti. Ann shares childhood revelations, her winning formula to writing 9 best-selling novels and why she decided to open a bookstore in Nashville. They both love Charlie Birds Farro salad so it’s on the menu for lunch along with Ina’s Jammy Eggs and Ann’s favorite Roasted cauliflower, one delicious grain salad two ways.

Preserving guru Pietro Demaio then demonstrates how easy it is to bottle your own olives, while acclaimed chef Peter Conistis makes magnificent olive and tomato keftedes with a green olive sauce.

programme.desc: Andy lands on The Rock in St. John's to eat like a Newfoundlander. He tries moose meat, scrunchions, steamed cod and a local twist on Chinese food. Then it's back home for baked beans and toutons.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 1
programme.desc: Luke explores and reminisces about his childhood growing up in Cabramatta. He meets with his high school friend Thai to cook a traditional Vietnamese Curry. Luke then takes us behind the scenes at his Sydney restaurant and cooks mouth-watering Pork Belly and a coconut milk fish.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 2
programme.desc: Luke takes us behind the scenes of his latest venture in Sydney. He explores his innovate machinery and high tech kitchen before meeting Head Chef Kenji to cook popular recipes from their menu. At the Sydney Fish Markets Luke meets with Executive Chef Chase Kojima and they plate up a Kingfish Ceviche before meeting with Paul Carmichael to learn more about Caribbean cuisine. Luke then meets Alan Benson, his photographer for his next book.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Saskatchewan produces nearly 80 percent of all the mustard in Canada and is one of the largest exporters of mustard in the world.

programme.desc: This episode is a salute to the fighting freshwater and saltwater barramundi. Alex Rogers whips up a simple dish with one of his favourite fish.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael works her magic in her upstate kitchen, turning a classic eggplant sub into a bold, sausage-style sandwich with a punchy blend of pantry spices.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura cooks a show-stopping entertaining dish, Fried Prawn Tacos, with Mike assisting with the guacamole. Next, Laura makes an Aussie treat Craisin Rocky Road. To wrap this episode, Laura prepares a simple Salt and Pepper Squid dish, perfect for when friends come around.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Meal To Make You Smile, A

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programme.desc: The award winning novelist and book store owner Ann Patchett is joining Ina for a fun filled day at the barn. Ann's best selling book Tom Lake is set on a cherry orchard so Ina is welcoming her with a simple country dessert, Cherry Clafouti. Ann shares childhood revelations, her winning formula to writing 9 best-selling novels and why she decided to open a bookstore in Nashville. They both love Charlie Birds Farro salad so it’s on the menu for lunch along with Ina’s Jammy Eggs and Ann’s favorite Roasted cauliflower, one delicious grain salad two ways.

programme.title: Freshly Picked
programme.desc: Today Simon explores hot and spicy flavours of Hot Chilli Mama, makes his delicious Cambodian fried rice, and prepares a delectable salad with fresh strawberries and creamy fetta.

programme.title: Food Safari Earth
programme.desc: It's the season of mellow fruitfulness and Maeve is on the road to Victoria's High Country in search of a wild mushroom bounty. Maeve joins her friend, homecook Franca Norris and her father, Angelo Bonacci, on a mushroom hunt amongst the pine trees before discovering the secrets of perfect gnocchi with mushroom sauce. Preserving guru Pietro Demaio then demonstrates how easy it is to bottle your own olives, while acclaimed chef Peter Conistis makes magnificent olive and tomato keftedes with a green olive sauce.

programme.desc: Bordeaux's world-famous vineyards are undergoing a revival as vintners seek to update their wines by introducing new technology and the reinvention older traditions. Eva visits St. Emillion where wine production began 1000 years ago and enjoys unusual wine pairings - a deep red with fish, and a buttery white with cheese. But Bordeaux isn't just about wine, it had superb produce; succulent duck and tender beef as well as 200-million-year-old caviar, served with signature Bordelaise sauces.

programme.desc: In Korea, on 6 September 1950, Lieutenant Benson's platoon finds itself isolated in enemy-held territory after a retreat. Soon they are joined by Sergeant Montana, whose overriding concern is caring for his catatonic colonel. Benson and Montana can't stand each other, but together they must get the survivors to Hill 465, where they hope the division is waiting. It's a long, harrowing march, fraught with all the dangers the elusive enemy can summon.

programme.title: The Comic

Packed with sharp satire, big laughs, and a bittersweet look behind the curtain of showbiz, The Comic delivers a fast, funny, and unforgettable ride through the life of a comedy genius who just can’t get out of his own way. A must-see for film lovers and comedy fans alike.

For them, the hold-ups are part of a last-ditch scheme to take back a future that was stolen from under them. Vengeance seems to be theirs until they find themselves on the radar of Marcus (Jeff Bridges), a Texas Ranger looking for one last grand pursuit on the eve of his retirement.
